verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Brex serves an llms.txt at developer.brex.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured table of contents. The developer docs themselves are served as markdown (.md URLs for guides, OpenAPI references, changelog and MCP docs), which gives an agent clean, agent-readable docs to consume. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full contents of the index beyond the truncated probe, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths 404).
